Overclocked.Description: By harnessing water-cooling technology from high-performance PCs, this variant pushes your weapon to fire faster than ever before, delivering unmatched speed at the cost of increased complexity
Overclocked.Explanation: Weapon variant with an increased fire rate and enhanced cooling capabilities, but slightly reduced ergonomics

Modified.Description: Upgraded to be a slightly better weapon, but its improved statistics come at the cost of sacrificing others
Modified.Explanation: Weapon variant in equilibrium with the universe, featuring adjustments to various aspects: reduced vertical recoil but increased horizontal recoil, improved ergonomics, lowered fire rate, increased heat buildup, and reduced weight

SMG.Description: A weapon for true gamblers—its fire rate depends entirely on how fast you can pull the trigger. Keep pulling, and eventually, you'll win
SMG.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 4.6x30mm HK caliber, featuring reduced recoil and an exceptionally high single-fire rate

Close Quarters.Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 12.7x55mm caliber, featuring reduced recoil, fire rate and muzzle velocity

20/70.Description: A typo in the weapon's description, left uncorrected out of sheer laziness. And now? Well, it's stuck like this-for better or for worse
20/70.Explanation: Shotgun variant chambered in 20ga shotgun cartridges

Shotgun-o-Revolver.Description: Somewhere, deep in the void of forbidden weapon concepts, someone asked: 'What if revolvers... but shotguns?
Shotgun-o-Revolver.Explanation: Revolver variant converted to fire shotgun shells. Because sometimes six big booms are better than six small ones

World War II.Description: If your goal isn't to kill your enemies but to seriously injure them, this is the perfect weapon for you. Now with occasional WW2 flashbacks!
World War II.Explanation: Bootleg of the PPSh-41. It even has the same fire rate and immunity to malfunctions! On top of that, it boasts low recoil

Slav \"Thing\".Description: If it works, don't question it. If it doesn't work, hit it with a wrench. Classic Slav engineering
Slav \"Thing\".Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 7.62x39mm with increased stabilization point, increased recoil, dispersion and decreased ergonomics

Freedom \"Thing\".Description: If it works, don't question it. If it doesn't work, shoot it until it does. Classic American engineering
Freedom \"Thing\".Explanation: Weapon variant chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO with decreased recoil, increased ergonomics and fire rate but with increased stabilization point

Smoothbore.Description: Technically not a rifle - at least according to someone’s paperwork. Modified to support civilian smoothbore cartridges while retaining most of the platform’s original handling. Whether that makes it legal, practical, or safe is another question entirely
Smoothbore.Explanation: Weapon variant capable of using both .366 TKM and 7.62x39mm ammunition
